summary: BYRONS is an independent Sydney mid-tier advisory firm (founded 1955, AFR Top 100 for 2026) with offices in Sydney CBD, Burwood, Melbourne and Brisbane and an outsourced/fractional CFO line. Partner Adam Dyson advises SMEs, is a certified MYOB consultant and, per the firm's own profile, oversees its offshore support operations including the Philippines team. Two earlier emails (16 and 23 Nov) went unanswered; this follow-up takes the offshore-review angle.
